12  KIMERA LABS INC.,                    Case No. 21-cv-2137-MMA (DEB)        

13                             Plaintiff,                                     
                                        ORDER GRANTING MOTION TO             
14  v.                                   SEAL                                 

15  RAJ JAYASHANKAR et al.,              [Doc. No. 58]                        
16                          Defendants.                                       
17                                                                            
18                                                                            
19       Plaintiff Plaintiff Kimera Labs Inc. (“Plaintiff”) brings this action against Raj 
20  Jayashankar, Exocel Bio Inc., Alejandro Contreras, Deb Hubers, and Craig Evan Winkels 
21  (collectively, “Defendants”) asserting, generally, that Defendants misappropriated its 
22  trade secrets in violation of 18 U.S.C. § 1836 et seq.  See Doc. No. 31.  Plaintiff now 
23  wishes to file an emergency motion for temporary restraining order, see Doc. No. 59, 
24  under seal, see Doc. No. 58.                                              
25       The strong presumption in favor of public access to court records, Phillips v. Gen. 
26  Motors Corp., 307 F.3d 1206, 1210 (9th Cir. 2002), may be rebutted by a showing of 
27  good cause to seal records attached to nondispositive motions, Kamakana v. City and 
28  Cnty. of Honolulu, 447 F.3d 1172, 1178 (9th Cir. 2006).  Having reviewed Plaintiff’s 
| |} motion to seal, good cause appearing, the Court GRANTS the motion and DIRECTS the 
2 || Clerk of Court to file Plaintiff's motion (Doc. No. 59) under seal. 
3         IT IS SO ORDERED. 
4    Dated:  February 22, 2023 
5                                              Mitek MM - Jills 
6                                             HON. MICHAEL M. ANELLO 
7                                             United States District Judge
